system_prompt_style.note: Repo has no code (README only). Paper says roles are distinguished by role-specific prompts, but it does not say how those prompts are produced.

env_context_strategy.note: No code. The paper describes a global memory retrieval step, but it gives no mechanism for providing repository or environment context.

context_compaction.note: Neither the paper nor the README discusses compaction, and there is no code to inspect.

observation_format.note: The paper mentions structured step-level feedback, but it does not specify an observation format.

tool_call_format.note: The paper states each specialist outputs a structured tool call (tool,args), but the syntax is not specified and no code is available.

tool_count.note: The paper figure shows an MCP Tool Service with 120 tools. These are MCP tools, which are excluded from this count, and no code is available.

edit_primitive.note: No code. The system is a remote-sensing agent, and no file-editing tool is described.

tool_schema_source.note: Based on the paper only. The README lists the MCP tool registry as not yet released.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Overall architecture of HiRS-Agent, including the Manager Layer, Specialist Layer, MCP tool service, Expert-tuning, and VG-HRL optimization.
protocol_standardization.note: Based on the paper and README; the code has not been released.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The workflow then proceeds through iterative execution, verification, and adaptive correction until task completion.
loop_primitives.note: Based on the paper only. The Manager Layer plans, routes and verifies, and replans on FAIL.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the Manager Layer formulates sub-goals and constraints, routes each sub-goal to an appropriate specialist agent

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The Manager Layer is instantiated as a singleOrchestrator Agent (OA), which serves as the core controller of HiRS-Agent.
multi_agent_topology.note: The paper describes two levels (OA plus specialists), which is an orchestrator-workers arrangement. All roles share one backbone.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the OA and specialist agents are prompt-conditioned role instantiations of the same backbone policy
delegation_mechanism.note: The exact mechanism is unclear. The paper describes routing to role prompts; subagent_spawn is also plausible.

human_in_loop.note: The evidence contains no code or config surface for human gating.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the OA maintains a structured global state

long_term_memory.note: The paper describes global memory within a run only; persistence across runs is not discussed.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the OA performs history-aware verification, which constitutes its core functionality
self_verification.note: Based on the paper only. The OA verifier uses the same shared backbone, so this is coded as self_critique. Schema-validity checks are also mentioned.

retry_policy.note: Task-level retry is not described. Step-level replanning and re-execution exist per the paper.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: determines the next action (e.g., continue, replan, verify, or terminate)
termination_condition.note: Based on the paper only. The OA decides when to terminate; no caps are described.

tracing.note: The paper figure mentions a 'Log file' in the output, but the logging mechanism is unspecified and no code is available.

eval_hooks.note: The README lists inference and evaluation code as not yet released.

target_domain.evidence_quote: HiRS-Agent** is a hierarchical multi-agent system for reliable long-horizon remote sensing (RS) task solving.

open_source.evidence_quote: The public implementation is not included yet and will be released after final packaging.
open_source.note: No LICENSE file exists and no code is published.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: all roles share the same Qwen3-4B or Qwen3-8B model
model_agnostic.note: The system uses fine-tuned Qwen3 LoRA backbones, and no provider abstraction is shown. The closest value is 'no'.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: This repository currently serves as the official project homepage and release tracker.

first_release_date.note: The date is the paper v1 date because there is no tag and no code.

pinned_version.evidence_quote: This repository currently serves as the official project homepage and release tracker.
pinned_version.note: There is no tag. The hash is the short hash given in the evidence header.

stars.note: The star count comes from the evidence header; its date is unknown.
